roles.leadHint: Manages the team's settings and members, and works its tickets.
roles.memberHint: Works the team's tickets and gets new ones by assignment.
roles.observerHint: Sees the team's tickets and can comment, but is never assigned.

list.title: Teams
list.description: Teams own work. Each one can have its own addresses, hours, signature and assignment, and a private team's tickets are only for its members.
list.newHint: Give the team a name and a colour. You can add people, addresses and hours next.
list.hiddenMembers: Only the team's members and admins see who is on a private team.
list.emptyHint: Create a team for each group that owns a kind of work, like Billing or Legal. Tickets to its address go straight to it.

tips.address: Give each team an address, like billing@, and its email lands there.
tips.private: Make a team private when its tickets are for its members only.

list.joinAsLeadHint: Leads manage the team's settings and members.
list.privateHint: Only the team's members and each ticket's assignee see its tickets.

general.title: General
general.name: Name
general.descriptionHint: What the team handles, shown in pickers. Up to 280 characters.
general.colorHint: Used for the team's dot and chips everywhere.

detail.notFoundBody: It was deleted, or you no longer have access to it.
detail.subtitle: {{open}} open, {{unassigned}} unassigned

members.title: Members
members.hint: Who is on the team, and what they do on it.
members.noneLeft: Everyone is already on this team
members.empty: No one is on this team yet. Add the people who work its tickets.
members.hidden: Only the team's members and admins see who is on a private team.
members.noLeadWarning: Give the team a lead, so someone can manage it.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.label: Private team
privacy.onHint: Only the team's members, observers and each ticket's assignee see its tickets.
privacy.offHint: Everyone in the workspace sees the team's tickets.
privacy.adminOnly: Only admins change a team's privacy.
privacy.whoSees: Admins are not exempt: an admin who is not on the team joins it as an observer to see its tickets, and the team is told.
privacy.makePrivateBody_one: Only the {{onTeam}} people on {{name}} and each ticket's assignee will see its tickets. {{people}} others, admins included, stop seeing its {{count}} open ticket.
privacy.makePrivateBody_other: Only the {{onTeam}} people on {{name}} and each ticket's assignee will see its tickets. {{people}} others, admins included, stop seeing its {{count}} open tickets.
privacy.makePublicBody: Everyone in the workspace will see {{name}}'s tickets again, including past ones.

join.title: Join {{name}}?
join.body: You join as an observer and start seeing its tickets. The team's leads are told that you joined, and it's recorded in the audit log.
join.note: {{name}} is private. You can change its settings, but its tickets are only for its members. Join to see them; the team is told.
join.noteMember: {{name}} is private. Its tickets are only for its members.

leave.title: Leave {{name}}?
leave.body: You stop getting {{name}}'s tickets by assignment.
leave.bodyPrivate: {{name}} is private: you stop seeing its tickets, except the ones assigned to you.

hours.title: Hours
hours.hint: Used for SLA timers on the team's tickets, the chat widget's open or closed state and Ollie's after hours answers.
hours.followsOff: Follows the workspace, which has business hours off: always open.
hours.noHolidays: No holidays. The team is open on public holidays unless you add them.

assign.title: Assignment
assign.hint: Who gets the team's new tickets.
assign.label: Assign new tickets
assign.precedenceHint: A team's method wins over its address's, which wins over the workspace default.

signature.title: Signature
signature.hint: Added to replies on the team's tickets, in place of the address's signature. Include each sender's own lines with {{tag}}. Leave it empty to use each address's own.

addresses.title: Addresses
addresses.hint: Email to these addresses goes to this team.
addresses.empty: No address goes to this team yet. Set its team on a mailbox, or route to it with a rule.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}
delete.hint: Its tickets, addresses, widgets and rules move to another team, or lose their team.
delete.dialogHint: This can't be undone. Choose where the team's work goes.
delete.moveHint: Open tickets, addresses, widgets, topics and rules go to {{name}}.
delete.noMoveHint: Tickets and addresses lose their team, and its routing rules are deleted.

brands.title: Brands
brands.description: What customers see: a name, colour and logo, the addresses that belong to it, its chat widgets and its help center.
brands.newHint: A brand is a product or company you support from this workspace.
brands.singleNote: You have one brand. Add another when you support a second product, and brand pickers appear across opendesk.
brands.name: Name
brands.slugInvalid: Use 3 to 40 lowercase letters, numbers and dashes.
brands.colorHint: Used by its widgets, help center and emails unless they set their own.
brands.notFoundBody: It was deleted, or the link is wrong.
brands.overviewHint: How the brand looks to customers.
brands.localeHint: For its widgets, help center and customer emails.
brands.logoHint: Shown in emails, the widget and brand chips.
brands.isDefaultHint: New addresses and tickets without one belong to it. The default brand can't be deleted.
brands.makeDefaultHint: New addresses and tickets without a brand belong to the default brand.
brands.makeDefaultBody: {{name}} becomes the default brand. Its first widget answers the old widget settings and key.
brands.deleteHint: Its widgets are deleted with it and stop loading on your sites.
brands.deleteBlocked_one: Move or remove its {{count}} address first.
brands.deleteBlocked_other: Move or remove its {{count}} addresses first.
brands.deleteBody_one: {{name}} and its {{count}} chat widget are deleted. The widget stops loading on your site.
brands.deleteBody_other: {{name}} and its {{count}} chat widgets are deleted. They stop loading on your sites.
brands.addressesHint: Mailboxes that belong to {{name}}. Replies to its tickets go out from them.
brands.addressesEmptyHint: Connect an address like support@ for {{name}}, and email to it opens tickets under this brand.
brands.addressesTip: Each address can send its email to a team.
brands.addWidgetHint: One widget per website. It uses {{name}}'s colour and logo until you change them.
brands.widgetsHint: Each website gets its own widget, with its own look, topics and team.
brands.widgetsEmptyHint: Add a widget for each website where customers should be able to chat with you.
brands.widgetsTip: Topics let visitors pick what they need, and route to the right team.
brands.widgetSecretHint: This is its identity verification secret. Copy it now: it is shown once.

widget.notFoundBody: It was deleted, or the link is wrong.
widget.description: A widget of {{brand}}. Changes show in the preview as you make them.
widget.generalHint: Its name and where its conversations go.
widget.name: Name
widget.nameHint: Usually the website, like Marketing site.
widget.teamHint: New conversations go to this team, unless a topic or rule says otherwise.
widget.teamPrivate: {{name}} is private: only its members see these conversations.
widget.colorHint: Leave it to use the brand colour.
widget.titleHint: Up to 40 characters. Empty shows the brand name.
widget.showTeamOf: Shows people on {{name}}, available ones first.
widget.offlineHint: What visitors see outside business hours.
widget.offlineTeamHours: Shown while {{name}} is closed, by its own hours.
widget.offlineWorkspaceHours: Shown while the workspace is closed. Empty uses a translated default.
widget.offlinePlaceholder: We're away right now. Leave a message and we'll reply by email.
widget.followUp: Reply by email when they leave
widget.followUpHint: A visitor who left an email and is no longer on the site gets your replies by email, from the brand's address for the team.
widget.followUpMailboxMissing: Add an active sending mailbox to this brand to send follow-up emails.
widget.installHint: Paste this before </body> on every page of this site.
widget.secretHint: Signs identify calls for {{name}}. Each widget has its own.
widget.rotateBody: The current secret for {{name}} stops working at once. Update your server before visitors sign in again.
widget.privateTeamNote: Conversations from this widget go to {{name}}, a private team.
widget.deleteHint: The widget stops loading on your site. Past conversations stay.
widget.deleteBody: {{name}} stops loading on your site right away. Past conversations stay in the inbox.

topics.title: Topics
topics.hint: When you add topics, the widget asks what the visitor needs before the first message, and the pick sends the conversation to its team.
topics.label: Topic {{n}}
topics.none: No topics: visitors start typing right away.

errors.duplicate: Each topic needs a different label.

help.title: Help center
help.enabledOn: Anyone with the link can read it.
help.pageTitleHint: Shown at the top and in search results.
help.urlHint: Share it, or link it from your site and widget.
help.urlHintDomain: On your custom domain. The default address redirects here.
help.urlOff: Live once the help center is published.
help.slugHint: Names this brand in the address every help center gets, even with a custom domain.
help.slugWarning: Links to {{old}} stop working. The help center moves to {{url}}.
help.slugWarningDomain: The default address moves to {{url}}, and links to {{old}} stop working. {{domain}} stays as it is.
help.lookHint: Pictures for the help center only. Empty uses the brand logo.
help.logoUsesBrand: Until you add one it shows the brand logo.
help.logoUsesWorkspace: Until you add one it shows the workspace logo.
help.faviconHint: The small icon in the browser tab.
help.articlesHint: Write and publish articles in the knowledge base.

domain.title: Custom domain
domain.hint: Serve the help center from an address of your own, like help.acme.com.
domain.label: Domain
domain.labelHint: A subdomain you control. You add two DNS records, and HTTPS is set up for you.
domain.connectingHint: Looking up its DNS records. This takes a few seconds.
domain.invalid: Enter a domain name like help.acme.com, without https:// or a path.
domain.taken: Another help center already uses this domain. Remove it there first.
domain.tooMany: That was a lot of checks in a short time. Try again in a minute.
domain.off: The help center is not published, so this domain shows nothing until you turn it on.

problem.txt_missing: The TXT record isn't there yet. Add it at your DNS provider: it proves the domain is yours.
problem.cname_missing: The CNAME record isn't there yet, or it points somewhere else. Point {{hostname}} to {{target}}.
problem.domain_taken: Another help center already uses this domain. Remove it there, then check again.
problem.certificate_pending: Both records are in place. The HTTPS certificate is being issued, which usually takes a few minutes.
problem.certificate_failed: The HTTPS certificate couldn't be issued. Check that the CNAME record points to {{target}} and isn't proxied, then check again.
problem.provider_error: Setting up the domain hit a problem on our side. It is tried again on its own, or check again in a few minutes.

domain.activeBody: Your help center now lives at {{url}}. The default address, {{fallback}}, redirects there.
domain.activeProblem: The help center still answers here, but fix this soon:
domain.failedBody: Checks stopped after 72 hours without finding the records. Fix them at your DNS provider, then check again.
domain.removeBody: The help center stops answering on {{hostname}} and is only at {{url}} again. You can delete the DNS records afterwards.
domain.recordsHint: Add these at the company where you manage {{zone}}'s DNS.
domain.relativeHint: If your provider adds the domain to names on its own, enter {{name}} as the TXT name.
domain.wait: DNS changes can take a few minutes, sometimes a few hours. Checks keep running, so you can leave this page.

routing.title: Routing
routing.description: How new tickets find their team: the address or widget first, then rules, triage and automations.
routing.newHint: When a new ticket matches, it goes to the team you pick.
routing.rulesHint: Checked from the top for every new ticket. Drag to change the order.
routing.emptyTitle: Route by what a ticket says
routing.emptyHint: Addresses and widgets already send tickets to their team. Add a rule to send, say, every invoice question to Billing whatever address it came in on.

tips.address: Without rules, each ticket goes to its address's or widget's team.
tips.order: Rules run top to bottom, and the first match decides.

flow.label: How a new ticket gets its team
flow.addressHint: Email goes to its address's team, chat to the topic's team, else the widget's. The API can name one.
flow.rulesHint: A matching rule moves the ticket to its team, whatever step 1 chose.
flow.afterHint: With no team yet, triage can pick one. Automations run last and can still change it.
flow.assignHint: The team's method picks a person, else the address's, else the workspace's.

routing.deleteBody: {{name}} stops routing new tickets. Tickets it already routed stay where they are.
routing.deleteHint: New tickets stop being routed by it.
routing.notFoundBody: It was deleted, or the link is wrong.
routing.name: Name
routing.enabledOff: Skipped until you turn it on.
routing.whenHint: The conditions a new ticket is checked against.
routing.question: Question for Ollie
routing.questionPlaceholder: Is this a question about a contract?
routing.aiNote: Ollie can't answer while a ticket is being routed, so this condition never matches here and the test shows it as unknown. To route on Ollie's answer, use a new ticket automation that sets the team.
routing.tooManyAi: Ask Ollie at most {{max}} questions in one rule.
routing.sendToHint: The team's assignment method then picks a person.
routing.needTeam: Choose the team this rule sends tickets to.

test.title: Test routing
test.hint: Write a sample email or chat and see where it would go. Nothing is created and no rule counts a run.
test.subject: Subject
test.bodyPlaceholder: Hi, I was charged twice this month.
test.stepNoDefault: No team from the address or widget
test.viaNone: Nothing, it stays without a team

scoped.slaTeamHint: Applies only to this team's tickets. The list order still decides, so put it above broader policies it should win over.
scoped.slaAnyHint: Applies to tickets of every team.
scoped.replyAddressHint: Must be an address of the ticket's brand; skipped otherwise.
scoped.privateTeamsHint: Tickets of private teams are left out unless you include the team. Only people on a private team can include it; anyone can take one out.
scoped.noAssignable: No one on this team takes new tickets.
scoped.precHint: A new ticket is assigned with the first method that is set, from left to right.
scoped.precTeamHint: Set on the team's page, or in the rules below.
scoped.precAddressHint: A mailbox rule below, for tickets without a team method.
